cv.name: Tyler Jankowski
cv.headline: Account Executive – Mid-Market SaaS | Customer Onboarding Background
cv.summary: SaaS seller with three years split between closing new business and onboarding customers for a logistics software company. Equally at home running discovery calls and leading implementations, and open to either sales or customer success roles.

experience.title: Account Executive, Mid-Market
bullets: Own a mid-market territory in the Midwest; closed $640K in new ARR in 2025 (112% of quota)
Run discovery, demos and pricing negotiations with operations and finance buyers
Partner with solutions engineers on security reviews and pilot plans
Hand over closed deals with detailed success plans to the onboarding team

experience.title: Onboarding Specialist
bullets: Onboarded 45 new customers, configuring carrier integrations and training dispatch teams
Kept 30-day activation rate above 90% for my cohort

experience.title: Sales Development Representative
bullets: Booked meetings through outbound calls and sequences in Outreach
